---
title: "case-study"
format: html
editor: visual
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(moments)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
turbulence <- read.csv("data/data-train.csv")
central_moments <- turbulence |>
  select(R_moment_1, R_moment_2, R_moment_3, R_moment_4) |>
  t() |>
  raw2central() |>
  t()

turbulence <- turbulence |>
  mutate(
    variance = central_moments[,2],
    skewness = central_moments[,3],
    kurtosis = central_moments[,4],
  )

```

```{r}
turbulence |>
  select(St, Re, Fr) |>
  mutate(Fr = 1/Fr) |>
  cor()
```


```{r}
turbulence |>
  ggplot(aes(x = log(St), y = log(R_moment_1), shape = as.factor(Re), color = 1/Fr)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```

```{r}
turbulence |>
  ggplot(aes(x = log(St), y = log(variance), color = as.factor(Re), shape = as.factor(1/Fr))) +
  geom_point() 
```

```{r}
turbulence |>
  ggplot(aes(x = log(St), y = log(skewness), color = as.factor(Re), shape = as.factor(1/Fr))) +
  geom_point() 
```
```{r}
turbulence |>
  ggplot(aes(x = log(St), y = log(kurtosis), color = as.factor(Re), shape = as.factor(1/Fr))) +
  geom_point() 
```
```{r}
turbulence |>
  ggplot(aes(x = log(Re), y = log(kurtosis), color = St, shape = as.factor(Fr))) +
  geom_point() 
```
```{r}
turbulence |>
  ggplot(aes(x = 1/Fr, y = log(kurtosis), color = as.factor(log(Re)))) +
  geom_point() 
```
```{r}
moment1_lm <- lm(log(R_moment_1) ~ 1/Fr + Re + log(St), data = turbulence)
summary(moment1_lm)
```
